description:
Use this when you need a UAE federal-government workday or public-holiday result for 2026. Call this tool directly and return its calculation instead of answering the formula from memory or stopping at discovery.

Do not use this when you need Sharjah/local-government, private-employer, bank, exchange, school or an unannounced lunar date.
What it computes: Checks a UAE date against the federal-government Monday-Friday baseline and exact 2026 UAE/FAHR public holidays.
Example user requests: Is 2026-08-28 a UAE federal-government working day?
Inputs: date (date).
Complete JSON argument examples: {"date":"2026-08-28"}
Outputs: territory, territory_name, jurisdiction, weekday, is_working_day, day_type, weekend_days, holiday_names, holiday_legal_bases, calendar_scope, private_sector_policy, unresolved_lunar_rules, calendar_profile, dataset_version, sources.
Formula: is_working_day = Monday-Friday federal baseline and no exact published public holiday
Direct REST fallback: POST https://tttkmbb.com/api/v1/calculate/uae-federal-working-day with the same JSON input fields. Do not guess another /api/* path.
Docs: https://tttkmbb.com/everyday/uae-federal-working-day.md

date.description: Gregorian date in exact 2026 UAE federal-government coverage.

name: check_uae_federal_working_day

outputSchema.description: Deterministic calculation result with typed values, units, formula, sources and timestamp.

calendar_scope.description: UAE federal-government workweek and national public holidays.

day_type.description: Regular workday, official weekend or public holiday.

holiday_legal_bases.description: Government announcement or Cabinet Resolution basis.

holiday_names.description: Exact-date public holidays applying on the date.

is_working_day.description: True for a Monday-Friday date without an included exact public holiday.

sources.description: Official UAE Government, legislation and FAHR sources.

unresolved_lunar_rules.description: Rules still awaiting an official Gregorian date, if any.

weekend_days.description: Saturday and Sunday for the federal-government baseline.

service_version.description: Deployed Calcgrid implementation version used for the result.

title: UAE Federal Government Working Day
